title: Application to Controller for eviction
verbatim_text:
(1) A landlord may apply to the Controller for an order directing the tenant to put the landlord in possession of the premises.
(2) The Controller may make an order directing the tenant to put the landlord in possession if: (i) the tenant has failed to pay or tender the rent within sixty days; (ii) the tenant has handed over possession to any other person without written consent; (iii) the tenant has committed acts impairing material value or utility; (iv) the tenant is guilty of nuisance; (v) the landlord requires the premises in good faith for his own occupation or that of his spouse or children.

title: Arrears of rent and deposit during proceedings
verbatim_text:
(1) Where a landlord applies for eviction, the Controller shall direct the tenant to deposit all arrears of rent admitted or determined by the Controller, and also to deposit the monthly rent regularly on or before the tenth of each month until the final disposal of the application.
(2) If the tenant fails to deposit the rent as directed, his defence shall be struck off and the landlord put in possession.

title: Appeal
verbatim_text: (1) Any party aggrieved by an order passed by the Controller, not being an interlocutory order, may prefer an appeal to the High Court within thirty days of the date of the order.
